title: Copyright Mob
description: Streamers beware! This mod adds the Copyright Mob, a relentless entity that roams your world. As soon as it spots you, it starts blasting loud copyrighted music and won't stop chasing you until you kill it. Silence the noise... if you can!
body:
# **The Copyright Mod**

Are you ready to face the ultimate content ID nightmare?

This mod introduces a new hostile mob: The Copyright. It looks like a walking copyright symbol, but its true weapon is audio.

**The Mechanic**: When the mob detects a player, it immediately plays random copyrighted hits from the 2008-2016 era (Pop, Memes, and Dubstep).

**The Challenge**: The music will loop and follow you everywhere. The only way to stop the song (and save your ears) is to kill the mob.

**The Reward**: Defeat it to silence the broadcast and unlock a unique achievement.

Perfect for trolling friends or adding some chaotic nostalgia to your survival world.
